why: Federation name of the former Zeon fortress Solomon (rows 2065, 2068, 2074, 2078, 2081). Gundam Wiki gives Confeito / Konpei Island; the episode page uses 'Konpeitoh'. 'Konpei Island' is the Gundam 0083 English-release name. Needs one locked spelling.
Row 2080. Katakana equals the Japanese name of Vella Lavella, an island of the Solomon Islands (the fortress is ex-Solomon). No English Gundam source found for this zone name.
Federation Naval Review at Konpei Island in Gundam 0083 (rows 2090, 2108, 2143).
Row 2116; source says only 'Stardust', so the word 'Operation' was not added.
Row 2094; standard Gundam rendering of the debris region.
Row 2058; Gainer's gaming-champion nickname, katakana is the English words.
Faction names as plain text in rows 2101-2102, 2115, 2124; Giganos is in the glossary, plain 'Zeon' follows batch 856 usage.
